purpose: Prespecified confirmation ablation, conditional on the frozen selected algorithm. This is not a new search grid: no checkpoint/configuration selection and no changes to the final method from its outcomes.
trigger: If the final 60-attempt discovery selection chooses joint energy, run its logodds-only ablation.
runs: Use the already registered canonical 42/43/44 and independent Original142/242/342/442/542 runs.
checkpoint: fixed final epoch last.pt even if its own selection J prefers a different endpoint; never reselect
selection: None. Register the complete method and stopping epoch before confirmations. Audit and test receipts are one-way. Ablation performance cannot change final method.
accounting: Report separately from the 60 capped discovery search attempts; disclose every prespecified fixed confirmation ablation, full compute, and any failures. No fallback hyperparameter variation.
rationale: Tests whether adding signed margin to true-class logodds is useful at the identical deployment configuration; no optimality claim for either statistic, and no claim of equal loss scale or FLOPs.
